items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today?

items.title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
items.summary: The user protection fund now sits below the $800 million level that Binance’s own rules say triggers a top-up, and the exchange hasn’t said when it will refill it.

items.title: Ark Invest buys $3.4 million in Coinbase, adds Circle and Robinhood as stocks trade lower
items.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest bought $3.4 million of Coinbase shares, $2.6 million of Circle, and $645,820 of Robinhood on Monday.

items.title: Chainalysis Puts Mercado Bitcoin Hack at $49 Million Across 17 Chains
items.summary: Mercado Bitcoin separately says $11 million has been blocked and promises no customer losses, while access to services remains suspended.
